query:
SELECT c.image_name,c.stable_key,c.object_name,c.npc_name,c.display_name,c.scene,r.ModelKey
FROM characters c JOIN raw.Characters r ON r.StableKey=c.stable_key
WHERE c.image_hash IS NOT NULL AND c.image_name IN (
 SELECT c.image_name FROM characters c JOIN raw.Characters r ON r.StableKey=c.stable_key
 WHERE c.image_hash IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.image_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.ModelKey)>1)
ORDER BY c.image_name,c.stable_key

classification.same-object-name: All trimmed, case-folded object names are equal.
classification.numbered-or-variant-copies: Object names differ but reduce to one family under the design context normalization.
classification.different-object-families: Remaining groups, including mixed families. These are object names, not a claim about runtime character identity or appearance.

model_labels: Each distinct raw Characters.ModelKey is numbered in order of first appearance, so equal labels mean equal model keys across all groups. The query returns the keys themselves.
